content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using [product_name] for the first time. I've connected the device to my PC with a USB cable. The software detects the port and lets me set the device's clock, but the transfer button to send data from the PC to the device is greyed out, so I can't click it. What could be the solution? Could it be because the device isn't in PC/[product_name] mode? How can I set this? I've tried accessing the menu and entering the program mode, but there is no program on the device.
Hello, What version of [product_name]_soft are you using (is it the demo version)? What type of [product_name] device ([article_no]) do you have? Regards,
Yes, it is the demo version. Is there a link to download version 6.1? I am using the [article_no].
Hello, You need to purchase the official software version from your local supplier.

Hello, With the demo version of [product_name]_soft, it's easy to get familiar with [product_name]. You can create, simulate, archive, and print circuit programs on a PC for all [product_name] devices. However, with the demo version, you cannot transfer programs to or from a [product_name] using a programming cable, nor can you do online monitoring or test a running program. These features are available only in the full software version. To use all features, you need to buy the full version of [product_name]_soft (any version from V4 onwards). This version can be upgraded to [version_no], which can program all older versions of [product_name] devices. It's important to select the correct device type in [product_name]_soft before starting your project. More details about demo software, upgrades/updates, and drivers can be found at: [url] Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a typical problem with demo versions of [product_name]_soft, where transferring programs from PC to the hardware device is disabled. While creation and simulation are allowed, actual device transfer is restricted, which often surprises new users who are unaware of these demo limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to send circuit programs from PC to hardware using demo software and a programming cable, similar to other available features.
